candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Thai conjunctions, particles, and frequent subword tokens used in Thai text processing.
This vector activates strongly for common Thai words, character fragments, and UTF-8 encoding artifacts.
This vector represents common Thai syllable prefixes, consonant-vowel clusters, and linguistic tokens used in Thai text processing.
This vector activates on diverse sub-word suffixes, prefixes, and character n-grams across multiple languages.
Tokens in this vector primarily represent the English word "camel" alongside various unrelated multilingual subwords and noise.
This feature vector activates on Thai script characters, indicating a language-specific tokenization artifact.
This vector represents Thai language text elements, including conjunctions, nouns, and common morphemes.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai script characters and common Thai syllable components.
These tokens represent quantifying adjectives and determiners in Thai used to indicate numbers, amounts, and distribution.
This feature vector is related to the Thai language, specifically containing Thai script fragments, grammatical suffixes, and characters common in Thai text processing.
